operations.name: Cliff Ulen

expected.charges: Interfering with the Selective Service System (the July 1970 Minnesota draft-board raids).
expected.sentence: Verdict as recorded: Convicted; most sentenced to five years and released July 1973.

updates.sentence: Pleaded guilty and received no prison time. The prison terms and July 1973 release reported for the seven other Minnesota Eight defendants do not apply to Ulen. Initial arrest is documented; the duration of any pretrial detention remains unverified.

operations.name: Homer C. Spence

expected.name: Homer C. Spence
expected.description: Homer C. Spence was a tenant farmer and an organizer for the Working Class Union (WCU), an interracial (white, Black, and Native American) socialist tenant-farmer organization in southeastern Oklahoma. The WCU led the Green Corn Rebellion of August 2-3, 1917 — an armed uprising of mostly young, poor farmers who opposed U.S. entry into World War I and the newly enacted Selective Service Act, and who planned to march on Washington to overthrow the federal government and end the war. The rebellion collapsed within two days under pressure from posses and federal officers, and roughly 450 people were detained. Spence — who was already out on bail for obstructing the 1917 draft — was tried for conspiracy and sentenced to ten years in the federal penitentiary at Leavenworth, Kansas, one of the heaviest sentences imposed on a Green Corn Rebellion organizer. He was pardoned by President Warren G. Harding in 1921. His mug shot ran in Butterick's Delineator (July 1918) in the magazine's gallery of Huns, Spies and Traitors.

operations.research_note: National Archives Leavenworth inmate index lists H.C. Spence, number 12027. Homer Carles Spence family history independently links this same number to the Green Corn draft-obstruction prisoner. This is a historical prison register number, not a modern BOP register number. Exact admission/release remain unverified; conflicting birth dates are not added. Corroboration: https://www.friede-abrahamson-genealogy.com/p2347.htm
